source.note: Verified 2026-08-07 via the board's JSON API (Greenhouse boards-api / Ashby posting-api); quotes verbatim in posting body. Compensation sentence changed; updated to current wording.

class_year.quote: You are a full-time undergraduate student studying computer science or a related field

process.quote: We do not allow multiple applications. Please apply to the ONE role you are most interested in and we will consider you for all open positions when reviewing your application.

compensation.quote: We offer a weekly base salary offer in addition to a competitive signing bonus, company-paid housing, meals, and other perks.
compensation.notes: Posting separately lists 'New York: Weekly base salary of 5,800 USD'. Prior quote ("We offer a weekly base salary offer in addition to a competitive signing bonus, ...") no longer on the posting.

cooling_off.notes: HRT's student FAQs (on /student-opportunities/, full FAQ section read) contain no reapplication, assessment-retake, or waiting-period rule. Closest FAQ item, verbatim: 'Can I apply for more than one job at the same time? Please only apply to one job posting. You will have the opportunity to indicate if you are interested in other offices or roles in the application questions.' That is a concurrent-application rule, not a cooling-off rule. Assessment note in job postings, verbatim: 'Use of AI tools during interviews or assessments is strictly prohibited, unless otherwise instructed or agreed upon.'
